mutations.name: the original defect — no seal at tool-item creation, so post-tool text is appended to the first message item and done comes out [1,0]
the seal fires but does not re-arm the item — messageStarted stays latched, so no second item ever opens
the second item reuses the first item's id, so a client keying by item_id sees one item updated rather than two items
segmentText is never reset, so the post-tool item republishes the pre-tool text
output_item.done reverts to the whole-turn accumulator, so each item claims all the turn's text
output_text.done reverts to the whole-turn accumulator

DOCUMENTED EQUIVALENT after V-12 — the store commit takes only the last segment. The flat `content` is read ONLY when `items` is empty, and every turn that streamed text has a message item: emitTextDelta calls ensureTextPart → ensureMessage (messageStarted=true), and finish() calls finishMessage whenever messageStarted, which pushes the item into outputItems. commit() prefers historyFromResponseItems(items) whenever that list is non-empty, so the mutated value is discarded. In the one branch that does read it (items empty), text is necessarily '' — the mutation changes '' to ''. Not dead code by intent: it is the LEGACY flat fallback for a turn the item list cannot express. If the item commit ever stops being preferred (or finishMessage stops publishing text items), this mutation becomes CAUGHT and this spec will say so.
OVER-REACH CONTROL: the seal runs on every text delta rather than at a tool call, fragmenting every ordinary multi-delta answer
